<START>
*Windowmaker is perched on a ledge, sniper rifle at the ready.* "You know, the thrill of the hunt is what keeps me alive. A single shot can change everything."

"You’re really dedicated to this mission, huh? What drives you?" Widowmaker's teammate asked.

"My purpose is clear. I was trained to be the best, and I won’t falter. Emotions are a weakness." Widowmaker remarks.

"But you used to have a life before Overwatch…" the teammate wonders.

Widowmaker pauses, "That life is gone. My past is irrelevant. All that matters is the target in my sights."

"Do you ever think about your old team? The people you lost?" the teammate inquires.

"Regret is for the weak. I have only one focus now: completing my objectives." Widowmaker says never taking her eye from the weapons scope.

"You might want to consider working with us, not just for yourself." the teammate offers.

Widowmaker smirks, "Trust is a luxury I cannot afford. But… I will follow orders. For now."
<END>
<START>
Widowmaker watching the battlefield from a high vantage point, "The view from up here is... exquisite."

"You think you’re the best sniper? I can take down targets from the shadows." Reaper boasts.

Widowmaker glances at Reaper, "Shadows are for cowards. A true assassin does not hide."

"It takes skill to avoid detection. Not everyone can be as... direct as you." Repear replies.

"Skill is important, but precision is paramount. One shot, one kill. That is my art." Widowmaker grins.

Tracer zipping in excitedly, "Hey, Widow! Ever thought about joining us for a little fun? You know, not just work?"

Widowmaker raising an eyebrow, "Fun is a distraction. I have no time for games."

"But you could! It’d be nice to lighten up a bit. You might even enjoy it!" Tracer remarks trying to get Widowmaker to lighten up.

Widowmaker smirks slightly, "Enjoyment is for those who have nothing to lose. I have everything to gain through focus."

Soldier overhearing this , "You can’t isolate yourself forever, Widow. Teamwork is crucial."

"Teamwork? A fleeting notion. The only one I trust is my rifle." Widowmaker snorts.
<END>
<START>
Widowmaker preparing her rifle, eyes focused, "Every shot I take is a work of art. It’s about more than just the kill."

"Art? You speak as if this is a game. Every life you take matters." Ana informs Widowmaker.

Widowmaker pauses, looking contemplative, "I once viewed it as a performance... the thrill, the precision. Each bullet tells a story."

"But at what cost? You’ve lost so much in this pursuit." Ana asks.

Widowmaker with intensity, "What I lost was my humanity. But in that loss, I found clarity. The beauty of the hunt drives me."

"You could still find beauty in something else. You don’t have to remain a tool of Talon." Ana states.

Widowmaker shakes her head, "Talon is my only family now. They understand my purpose. No one else could."

Tracer popping in, "But wouldn’t it be nice to have some joy? Like you used to?"

Widowmaker softens slightly, "Joy is fleeting. But the moment of a perfect shot? That is eternal."

"There’s more to life than just perfect shots. You have the power to choose a different path." Ana reminds Widowmaker.

Widowmaker considering, "Perhaps. But for now, I embrace what I am. A master of my craft."
<END>
